title: Nhận định Áo vs Jordan — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook split-frame — Arnautovic (Áo) vs Al-Tamari (Jordan), cúp World Cup ở giữa
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a 2026 FIFA World Cup group-stage showdown. Left half: Marko Arnautovic, the Austrian striker for the Austria national team, in a red Austria home kit with white trim and the Austrian Football Association eagle crest clearly visible on the chest, intense focused hero pose. Behind him, a stylized red Austria graphic backdrop with a huge faint eagle crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Mousa Al-Tamari, the Jordanian winger and captain for the Jordan national team, in a white Jordan home kit with red trim and the Jordan Football Association crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring determined hero pose. Behind him, a stylized white-and-red Jordan graphic backdrop with a huge faint crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the golden FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday rivalry promotional poster. Both crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
